name: Hanging Leg Raise
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with hands shoulder width and arms straight.
Pull your shoulders slightly down and keep your body still.
Breathe out and raise your legs until they are level with your hips.
cues: Bend knees to make it easier

common_mistakes.mistake: Swinging to get the legs up
common_mistakes.fix: Pause at the bottom; switch to knee raises if needed
Tuck the hips slightly as the legs rise
Use a captain's chair until grip catches up
